ADVENTURER_HUD.Title: Adventurer HUD
ADVENTURER_HUD.Keybindings.Open.Name: Toggle Adventurer HUD
ADVENTURER_HUD.Keybindings.Open.Hint: Open or close the HUD for the selected token or assigned character. The shortcut can be changed in Foundry's Configure Controls screen.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.keepOpen.Name: Keep the window open
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.keepOpen.Hint: Keep the rolls window open after a successful roll.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.adaptiveLayout.H: Adapt grids, spacing and text size to the window width.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.fontSize.Name: Text size
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.fontSize.Hint: Choose the base size of HUD text and values.
Update an open HUD when another token is selected. Disabled by default so an open HUD remains attached to its original character.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showInitiative.H: Show initiative beside the actor name in combat mode.
Show range, action type and spell tags on combat cards. The description button is always available.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showModeNavigati: Show buttons for switching among regular, combat, and death-save modes. Automatic mode detection continues to work independently.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showModeHeadings: Show the heading blocks in combat and death-save modes.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatResour: Show the character's class and custom resources in combat mode.
Show HP, temporary HP, AC, speed, and related combat values.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showConditions.H: Show removable active-condition icons in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatWeapon: Show the weapons tab in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSpells.Name: Show spells
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSpells.Hint: Show the spell browser in regular and combat modes.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatAction: Show the actions tab in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatBonusA: Show the bonus actions tab in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatReacti: Show the reactions tab in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatSpecia: Show the special actions tab in combat mode.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showAbilityCheck: Show the ability check row in the main view.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSavingThrows: Show the saving throw row in the main view.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSkills.Name: Show skills
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showTools.Name: Show tools
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showTools.Hint: Show the tools and instruments section.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showDeathSaves.H: Enable the death saves view when the character is at 0 HP.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showShortcuts.Hi: Show modifier-key hints at the bottom of the HUD.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.automaticCombatM: Automatically switch to the combat HUD when the selected token participates in an active combat.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.MenuHint: Configure behavior, appearance, and visible sections of Adventurer HUD.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Name: Additional settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Hint: Configure less frequently used visibility, token tracking, and navigation options.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Label: Open additional settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Name: Reset Adventurer HUD settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Hint: Restore module options to their defaults.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Label: Reset settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Confirm: Reset all Adventurer HUD options to their default values? Window position and size will be preserved.
